name: SharePoint Scoped Search
description: Full-text search for files and documents restricted to a specific SharePoint site or subfolder

authFields.label: SharePoint site URL
authFields.description: Base URL of the target SharePoint site to search within, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/marketing. Results will be restricted to this site.

authFields.label: SharePoint site ID
authFields.description: Optional composite Microsoft Graph site ID (e.g. host,siteCollectionId,webId). When provided, strictly filters search hits to this site.

authFields.label: Subfolder / Library path
authFields.description: Optional default subfolder or document library path to restrict all searches to, e.g. 'Shared Documents/Policies' or 'HR/Onboarding'.

actions.name: Search files in site
actions.description: Searches files in the configured SharePoint site or subfolder by file name or full-text search within document contents.

inputFields.label: Query
inputFields.description: Search for file contents/names, or paste a SharePoint URL to find a specific file, i.e. 'quarterly revenue', 'https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/YourSite/Shared%20Documents/Subfolder/document.pdf' or "*" to list all files

inputFields.label: Subfolder
inputFields.description: Optional subfolder or library path to narrow this specific search (e.g. 'Shared Documents/2024' or 'SOPs'). Appends to or overrides the connection-level subfolder.

inputFields.label: Max results
inputFields.description: Maximum number of matching files to return. Defaults to 25. Maximum is 100.

actions.failedLabel: Failed to search files in site
